machine.gpu: AMD Radeon Graphics / Renoir, Mesa Rusticl and RADV

method.layer_dispatch: Direct CPU, explicit CpuScope workers=1 or 4
method.model: Two Linear/SiLU pairs, float32, MSE, AdamW
method.model_threads: OMP setting; autotune disabled implies serial CPU ranking. Autotune variant marked per case.
method.environment: OMP_PLACES={11} for one worker, {8},{9},{10},{11} for four. ROCm execution disabled.
method.timing_caveat: Shared machine with another training workload. Baseline and initial candidate interleaved; final candidate re-run after small-reduction tuning. Absolute times and small differences may vary.
method.compiler: GCC 15; portable C++17 core O3; standalone layer harness O2; SimdDispatch -ffp-contract=off

validation.rocm: HIP compilation for gfx90c only; no execution
validation.cuda: Source review; no nvcc or NVIDIA device

scratch.scope: Calling-thread C++ new/new[] only, warmed buffers; tokens 1/7/13, embed_dim 32, 4 heads.
